external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of three insurance partners that provides daily claim extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.
external_entities.notes: The source names three partners but provides no distinguishing names, so they are represented as one entity.

external_entities.name: analyst
external_entities.description: An analyst who queries the warehouse directly.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler that lists and reads files from the landing bucket and triggers Spark transform jobs.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A Spark job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket receiving daily claim extract files from insurance partners.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted"; "Both are on defaults as far as I know."

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow's metadata database containing connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: "I don't know ... whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest."; "Both are on defaults as far as I know."

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse into which normalized claim records are loaded and which analysts query directly.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.

data_flows.name: drop daily extract
data_flows.description: An insurance partner pushes a daily claim extract into the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_flows.data_description: Claim records with member names and dates of birth

data_flows.name: read files
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler lists and reads files from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.

data_flows.name: read metadata
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler accesses its metadata database for connection strings and partner keys.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

data_flows.name: trigger transform job
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.

data_flows.name: load records
data_flows.description: The Spark transform job loads normalized claim records into BigQuery.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.

data_flows.name: query warehouse
data_flows.description: An analyst queries the warehouse directly using SSO.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Analysts query the warehouse directly. They are on the warehouse network and authenticate with SSO

trust_boundaries.name: landing network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the Airflow scheduler runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network

trust_boundaries.name: warehouse network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the Spark transform job runs and the analysts are located.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data because it stores claim records with member names and dates of birth.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the extracts contain claim records with member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow metadata database contains confidential data because it stores connection strings and partner keys.
assumptions.basis: The source states that Airflow keeps connection strings and partner keys in the database.

assumptions.assumption: BigQuery contains confidential data because it stores normalized claim records containing member names and dates of birth.
assumptions.basis: The source states that normalized claim records are loaded into BigQuery, and the extracts contain member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: SFTP provides intrinsic encryption in transit for the partner-to-bucket flow.
assumptions.basis: The source states that partners push files over SFTP; SFTP encryption is intrinsic.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow scheduler presents a non-web interface because it is described as a scheduler performing batch file processing.
assumptions.basis: The source describes Airflow as a scheduler that wakes at a scheduled time, lists files, and processes them.

assumptions.assumption: The Spark transform job presents a non-web interface because it is described as a transform job processing files.
assumptions.basis: The source describes Spark as a transform job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
